title: URL-Encoding Filter Bypass in is_safe_static_path Leading to Full Sensitive File & Source Code Disclosure
description: is_safe_static_path checks self.path without URL-decoding (unquoting) it first. Requesting %2eenv or %62ackend/server.py bypasses the dotfile and forbidden directory string matching, and SimpleHTTPRequestHandler then unquotes and serves the file.
remediation: Call urllib.parse.unquote() on the path, resolve the canonical realpath with os.path.realpath, and ensure it strictly resides inside allowed public directories.

title: Missing Bounds & Arithmetic Integrity Validation in handle_create_requisition (Negative Stock Injection)
proof_of_concept: POST /api action=createRequisition with totalPieces: -1250 and qtyBoxes: -5 succeeds and can be approved/completed to artificially inflate on-hand inventory.
description: handle_create_requisition checks if total_pieces > available, but does not verify that total_pieces > 0 and that total_pieces equals (qty_boxes * ratio) + qty_pieces.
remediation: Enforce qty_boxes >= 0, qty_pieces >= 0, and verify total_pieces == (qty_boxes * db_item['pieces_per_box']) + qty_pieces, with total_pieces > 0.

title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) via Unescaped Item Attributes in Catalog and Inventory Displays
proof_of_concept: Creating an item with name or image containing attribute breakouts (e.g. " onerror="alert(1)" x=") executes JavaScript in any user or staff browser rendering the catalog.
description: In renderItemGrid (index.html) and renderInventoryTable (staff.html), item attributes (name, unit_box_name, unit_piece_name, image_piece, image_box) are interpolated directly into innerHTML without escapeHtml().
remediation: Apply escapeHtml() to all dynamic item fields before string template interpolation.

title: Uncontrolled Resource Consumption via Unbounded Content-Length in HTTP POST Handler
proof_of_concept: Sending Content-Length: 2147483648 causes the server to attempt a 2GB memory allocation via self.rfile.read(content_length).
description: do_POST directly reads the full length specified by the client header without an enforced maximum byte limit.
remediation: Enforce MAX_BODY_SIZE = 10 * 1024 * 1024 (10MB) and return HTTP 413 Payload Too Large if Content-Length exceeds this threshold.

title: Missing Caller Authentication on Requisition Creation Allowing Identity Spoofing
proof_of_concept: Direct POST /api action=createRequisition with arbitrary requester name ('นางสาววาสนา จันทร์จ่าย') succeeds without requiring any session token or password.
description: While the frontend enforces login before showing the submission form, the backend REST endpoint accepts arbitrary requester names and departments from any unauthenticated caller.
remediation: Require requester session tokens or validate requester identity against the authenticated user.

title: Use of Hard-Coded Default STAFF_AUTH_SECRET in Configuration and Fallback
proof_of_concept: Computing HMAC-SHA256 signature using the default secret allows forging valid staff tokens without knowing the staff password.
description: Default placeholder value 'sdu_inventory_staff_secret_token_change_in_production' is present in .env and server code default fallback.
remediation: Generate a cryptographically secure random token on startup if unset, or log a fatal configuration error in production if the default secret is retained.
